caption: Table 46-21. Summary of evidence for treatments used to manage cats with idiopathic cystitis, struvite uroliths or urethral plugs and calcium oxalate uroliths.*
rows: Long-term treatment with amitriptyline (6 to 9 months) for severe cases
Increased salt intake to stimulate urine dilution
Additional methods to stimulate water intake
Analgesics and nonsteroidal antiinflammatory drugs during acute episodes
Other therapeutic foods formulated to dissolve uroliths
Prevention of struvite urolith or urethral plug recurrence
Hill's Prescription Diet s/d (for urethral plug prevention)
Other therapeutic foods formulated to prevent struvite disease
Decreasing risk of calcium oxalate recurrence**
Hill's Prescription Diet x/d Feline (currently available as c/d Multicare Feline)
Other therapeutic foods formulated to prevent calcium oxalate
Using other methods (in addition to moist food) to increase water intake
